title: Peace In Storms
verse: So he got up and rebuked the wind, and said to the sea, “Be quiet! Calm down!” Then the wind stopped, and it was dead calm.
observation: It is crazy to me to think that God can calm literal storms, but we do not always think God can calm the storms in our lives. We have trouble equating the two because our storm seems too big. However, I am sure this storm seemed like the end for those in the middle of it. If God can do that, what can He do in our lives?
application: How can I trust God more with my storms?
prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being in the middle of the storm with us.
